meta.name: stakeholder-map
meta.description: Build a stakeholder map using a power/interest grid, identify communication strategies per quadrant, and generate a communication plan. Use when managing stakeholders, preparing for a launch, aligning cross-functional teams, or planning stakeholder engagement.

copy.tagline: 绘制干系人权力/利益矩阵并生成沟通计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要系统化识别和管理项目干系人
copy.tagline_en: Build a stakeholder power/interest grid and generate a communication plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to systematically identify and manage project stakeholders

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你列出项目相关方，按权力和兴趣高低分类到四个象限，并为每个象限推荐沟通频率、渠道和关键信息，最后生成一张沟通计划表。
howto.when: 当你需要管理项目相关方、准备产品发布、协调跨职能团队或规划相关方参与时，可以要求 Claude 构建相关方地图。

say.text: 帮我为新产品发布构建相关方地图。
say.note: Claude 会列出相关方并分类到权力-兴趣网格。

say.text: 列出这个项目的相关方，并给出沟通策略。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含频率和渠道的沟通计划表。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you list project stakeholders, classify them into a Power × Interest grid, recommend communication frequency, channel, and key messages per quadrant, and generate a communication plan table.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you need to manage stakeholders, prepare for a launch, align cross-functional teams, or plan stakeholder engagement.

say_en.text: Build a stakeholder map for the new product launch.
say_en.note: Claude will list stakeholders and place them in the grid.

say_en.text: List stakeholders for this project and suggest communication strategies.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a communication plan table.
